author: Chris Montcalmo
title: Baltimore County to hold annual public hearing on water supply and sewerage plan amendments - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Montcalmo ,
9 hours ago TOWSON, MD—The Baltimore County Planning Board has scheduled its annual public hearing to review proposed amendments to the county’s Water Supply and Sewerage Plan.
The meeting will begin at 5 p.m. on July 16, 2026 in Room 104 of the Jefferson Building, located at 105 West Chesapeake Avenue in Towson. During the session, the board will evaluate petitions from property owners seeking to change their current water and sewer service level designations.
County officials are encouraging residents to attend the hearing and provide public testimony regarding the proposed service changes. A map and a comprehensive list of the specific properties involved in the petitions have been made available by the county for public review (PDF) .
Detailed reports regarding each amendment are expected to be published on the Baltimore County Department of Public Works and Transportation’s website in early July.
Individuals who require special accommodations for disabilities are asked to contact the county at (410) 887-3480 in advance to facilitate necessary arrangements for the meeting.
